findings.description: Read Delivery Evidence now takes 'the fetched initiative, epic and task issue JSON' and passes them to Read Initiative Pull Requests, which finds Development-linked pull requests only on the issues supplied. Three callers still name only the initiative and epics, or no inputs: modes/align-mode.md:95 ('for the selected initiative and epics'), modes/deliver-mode.md:61 ('for the affected initiative and epics') and protocols/task-merge.md:29 ('Follow Read Delivery Evidence'). A caller following them omits task issue files, so a pull request linked only through a task issue's Development field and titled without the prefix is missed; the refetch loop that used to recover it was removed from delivery-evidence.md step 2. Fix: name the initiative, epic and task issue JSON in each of those three calls, as sync-mode.md:50 does.

[items.json]', which reads as an optional positional argument; argparse defines none, and a board items file is passed as one of the --issues values. Fix: drop '[items.json]' or show '--issues items.json' as a second usage line.
